mapper.sql: id, user_id, document_id, parent_chunk_id, chunk_level, chunk_text, chunk_type, title_path, context_prefix, source_strategy, is_searchable, ts_content, sort_order, node_metadata, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chunks (user_id, document_id, parent_chunk_id, chunk_level, chunk_text, chunk_type, title_path, context_prefix, source_strategy, is_searchable, sort_order, node_metadata) VALUES (#{userId}, #{documentId}, #{parentChunkId}, #{chunkLevel}, #{chunkText}, #{chunkType}, #{titlePath}, #{contextPrefix}, #{sourceStrategy}, #{isSearchable}, #{sortOrder}, CAST(#{nodeMetadata, typeHandler=org.linxing.linxing_agent.agent.handler.JsonListTypeHandler} AS jsonb))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM chunks WHERE document_id = #{documentId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT FROM chunks WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT FROM chunks WHERE id IN
#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE chunks SET chunk_type = #{chunkType}, title_path = #{titlePath}, context_prefix = #{contextPrefix}, is_searchable = #{isSearchable}, ts_content = to_tsvector('simple', #{tsContent}) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM chunks WHERE parent_chunk_id = #{parentChunkId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC
SELECT FROM chunks WHERE document_id = #{documentId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC

SELECT c.id AS chunkId, c.document_id AS documentId, c.chunk_text AS chunkText, c.title_path AS titlePath, c.chunk_type AS chunkType, d.file_name AS fileName, ts_rank(c.ts_content, query) AS bm25Score, c.parent_chunk_id AS parentChunkId, c.node_metadata::text AS nodeMetadata FROM chunks c CROSS JOIN to_tsquery('simple', #{keywords}) query LEFT JOIN documents d ON c.document_id = d.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.is_searchable = true AND c.ts_content @@ query ORDER BY bm25Score DESC LIMIT #{limit}
